comment: Kept by the lead session. This is the lead's record of work that has not landed yet, not a measured fact. It ships EMPTY on purpose: it is a working file for whoever is working on this clone, not a log of what the last person did. Two runs are kept in git rather than here: the 94 jobs of the rewrite the article describes are at 16f829c, and the release-day chain (stages, compare, the three looks, the gate, the snapshot; 3h24m) is at b2041dd. git show <commit>:docs/ledger-queue.json reads either one back.
